observations.body: Sabbath is called a perpetual sign and covenant marker; after speaking on Sinai, God gives Moses two stone tablets written with God’s finger.
observations.label: Sabbath sign and stone tablets close the mountain speech

observations.body: Sabbath sign and stone tablets close the mountain speech belongs to tablets and dwelling in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 31:12–18 supplies consequence evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: What follows from Sinai

observations.body: The tablets and dwelling instructions develop the consequences of Sinai presence; they are not additional lines inside the Ten Words.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 31:12–18 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Sabbath sign and stone tablets close the mountain speech follows from Sinai while remaining distinct from the words and actions at the mountain itself.
payload.title: Sabbath sign and stone tablets close the mountain speech
